notes.title: New Update!
notes.content: A new patch is available with additional content at the end of the game. The content will extend the storyline a bit further from the end What could lie in the depths of the forest? This update is entirely free.

notes.title: Upcoming Changes
notes.content:
We’d like to thank the community for the valuable feedback you gave us this week. Since the release we made a few changes to the game and we’re planning to make a little more.
Changes already implements: 
      - Added a hint on the load menu, advising players to search for the flashlight.
      - Made some changes on the light produced by the candles, to attract players to the path that leads to the flashlight.
Changes planned (sorted by priority):
      - Fix a bug that is preventing the game from remembering the selected configuration after quitting the game.
      - Add an exit button on the main menu (currently only on the game menu).
      - Add Steam Trading Cards.
      - Add Steam Achievements.
We’ll be working on said changes in the coming weeks, please bear in mind that adding Trading Cards and Achievements might take some time, we’ll focus on Trading Cards first. 
If you find any bugs or have suggestions, let us know about it at the discussion forum in the Steam Community Hub.
